query: Digital Realty Q2 2026 AI-related leasing demand or revenue
normalized: 2026 ai demand digital leasing q2 realty related revenue

output.content:
**Q2 2026 takeaway:** Digital Realty did not disclose a separate amount of *recognized AI revenue*, but it did quantify AI-related leasing demand within its small-footprint/interconnection business. [[1, 2]]

- Q2 total bookings were **$307 million of annualized GAAP rental revenue at 100% ownership**, or **$208 million at Digital Realty’s share**. [[1]]
- The **0–1 MW category plus interconnection** contributed **$108 million** at Digital Realty’s share—$88 million from 0–1 MW deployments and $20 million from interconnection—and represented a record level of bookings. [[1, 2]]
- Management said AI-related wins accounted for **roughly 20% of that $108 million**, implying approximately **$21.6 million of annualized GAAP base rent** tied to AI-related leasing in this category; this is an estimate based on management’s “roughly” qualifier rather than a separately reported revenue line. [[2]]
- Management characterized these wins as diverse, generally sub-1-MW/network-oriented deployments, including private-AI and broader service-provider demand, rather than a concentrated large single-customer or single-site lease. [[2]]
- Overall Q2 reported operating revenue was **$1.924 billion**, including **$1.146 billion of rental revenue**, but Digital Realty did **not** identify what share of either figure was generated by AI customers or workloads. [[1]]
- Demand evidence extended beyond the quarter: Digital Realty said it signed two hyperscale leases in July worth **$410 million of annualized GAAP base rent at 100% share** ($205 million at its share), while its Q2-ending backlog reached **$1.9 billion at 100% share** ($1.4 billion at its share). [[1, 3]]

**Bottom line:** AI was a material and growing leasing contributor—about **$22 million of annualized rent implied within the $108 million connected-capacity segment**—but the company’s disclosures do not support treating that figure as Q2 AI revenue or as total AI-related leasing across all Digital Realty product categories. [[2, 1]]
